Two Ways To Enter

REAL MONEY & COIN TOURNAMENTS

Pick how you want to enter a match: with money from your Money Wallet, or with coins from your Coin Wallet.

VS
ENTRY WITH MONEY (₹)

REAL MONEY TOURNAMENTS

Entry fee is paid from your Money Wallet. Rewards depend on tournament results.

  • Paid tournament entry
  • Money wallet
  • Tournament participation
  • Prize rewards
  • Match earnings
  • Withdrawal functionality
ENTRY WITH COINS

COIN TOURNAMENTS

Entry is paid with coins from your Coin Wallet. No money entry fee required.

  • Coin-based entry
  • Coin wallet
  • Daily coin claim
  • Referral coin rewards
  • Coin history
  • Coin-to-money conversion

Rewards depend on match results and tournament rules. Winnings are never guaranteed. Please play responsibly.
